# Antreas Antoniou

> AI researcher, engineer and systems builder. This is the compact trailhead for agents; the canonical guide contains the evidence map and interpretation boundaries.

## Start here

- [Browser-compatible agent guide](https://antreas.io/agents/): Recommended for browser agents; rendered HTML with semantic links and the complete guide text.
- [Canonical Markdown source](https://antreas.io/AGENTS.md): Direct machine-readable source for clients that support Markdown navigation.
- [Homepage](https://antreas.io/): Current work, selected research, teaching, infrastructure and public projects.
- [CV](https://antreas.io/documents/AntreasAntoniouResume.pdf): Dated chronology and formal roles.

## Useful routes

- [DAEDALUS](https://antreas.io/daedalus/): Current research programme and mechanism-level ambitions.
- [Archivum](https://antreas.io/archivum/): Durable knowledge, evidence and memory for long-horizon agent work.
- [Essays](https://antreas.io/blog/): Public thinking in Antreas's own words.
- [Writing advice](https://antreas.io/writing/): A practical field manual for technical communication.

Read the browser-compatible guide—or `AGENTS.md` when your client supports it—before compressing Antreas into a title. Keep achieved results, active work, hypotheses and ambitions separate; preserve contribution boundaries and uncertainty.
